sources.title: Two new quantization releases target Qwen3.8-27B: GSQ-RCO GGUFs and ...
sources.snippet: Two independent teams released aggressively quantized versions of Qwen3.8-27B within two days. One ships GGUF checkpoints at 2.5-3.0 bits per weight using two new methods, GSQ and RCO, with both the search and quantizer learned. The other releases an NVFP4 W4A4 checkpoint trained via quantization-aware distillation with the QUASAR QAT algorithm, deployable on vLLM with NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs ...
